scope: Ordinary supervised bounded metric-adapter family; no independent innovation credit without a concrete additional mechanism and its ablations.
input: RGB appearance, cue-guided appearance minus RGB appearance, cue HOG, and local contrast qualities; RGB control repeats RGB quality and never reads IR quality
initialization: Zero last layer; output exactly equals normalized preserved RGB embedding before fitting
normalization: Train-only feature means and standard deviations, std floor 0.05
lr_schedule: Cosine from 0.001 to 0.0001 over 36 epochs, unchanged if extended
sampling: Uniform Train video, up to eight identities with replacement for small videos, temporally spread observations of each identity
loss: Within-video fixed RGB identity-prototype cross entropy at temperature 0.1 + 0.5 temporal batch-hard triplet margin 0.2 + 0.05 squared deviation from frozen RGB embedding
selection: Complete Dev HOTA only; keep all seeds and paired RGB cue controls; no Test selection
storage: One atomic resumable latest per arm; small six-epoch inference candidates kept for Dev selection, total under 64 MiB for this family; no weights in Git
stopping: At common epoch18 and later six-epoch checks, extend all six fits together if any best Dev HOTA improves by more than 0.2pp over the best through 12 epochs earlier; otherwise stop. Cap at36. All formal Test runs use Dev-selected weights.
